title: Stop Overvaluing Multi-Agent Debate—We Must Rethink Evaluation and Embrace Model Heterogeneity
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the reasoning and performance capabilities of multi-agent debate (MAD) frameworks in LLMs using general benchmarks like MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval. It does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, morals, or ethics, although it mentions in the appendix that some prior works used moral subsets of MMLU.
